findings.title: Health data confidentiality (GDPR art. 9)
findings.evidence: No document states that health information shared for adjustments is confidential or specifies who may see it.
findings.first_step: Add a confidentiality clause: only the People team sees health details; the manager sees only the agreed adjustments.

findings.title: Issue templates with acceptance criteria
findings.first_step: Add a feature template with an 'Acceptance criteria' checklist.

findings.title: Markdown images have alt text
findings.evidence: 3 image(s) without alt text: ARCHITECTURE.md (1), docs/setup.md (2).
findings.first_step: Add alt text that says what each image shows.

findings.title: Captions/transcripts for ceremonies
findings.evidence: Brightline Software · Engineering Handbook > 4. Communication > 4.3 Meetings and cameras: "Pulse (the all-hands) is recorded and has captions. Team ceremonies (planning, refinement, retro) are not recorded." · Documents state all-hands has captions but explicitly say team ceremonies are not recorded; they do not provide captions or transcripts for those ceremonies, nor for trainings.
findings.first_step: Turn on captions for planning, refinement and retro, and share notes afterwards.

findings.title: Adjustments process incl. assistive tech
findings.evidence: Brightline Software · Workplace Adjustments Policy > 4. How to ask: "Talk to your manager, or write to the People team at people@brightline.example if you prefer not to talk to your manager first." · The documents describe how to ask and examples including equipment but do not specify a response time; assistive technology is not explicitly named (only generic equipment like keyboards/mice/monitor).
findings.first_step: Add a response time (e.g. 10 working days) and assistive technology (screen readers, captioning) to the policy.

findings.title: PR template has How to test
findings.evidence: .github/pull_request_template.md has only "Summary", "Related issue"; no "How to test".
findings.first_step: Add a 'How to test' section to the PR template.
